promise: "We will pursue our manifest destiny into the stars, launching American astronauts to plant the Stars and Stripes on the planet Mars."
description: In the January 20, 2025 inaugural address, Trump said the United States would pursue sending astronauts to Mars. That passage gave no mission date or end-of-term deadline.
evidence: No crewed Mars mission approved or scheduled as of mid-2026
NYT analysis: a Mars landing cannot happen before 2029 due to orbital windows

review.note: The inaugural statement is verified but contains no January 2029 deadline. The orbital-impossibility assertion and claim of no approved mission require separate technical/current evidence; remove rather than present them as established.

promise: Stargate will invest up to $500 billion in US AI infrastructure, with $100 billion starting immediately
description: Stargate announced an intention on January 21, 2025 to invest $500 billion in US AI infrastructure over four years, beginning deployment of $100 billion immediately. OpenAI reported in April 2026 that it had secured more than 10GW of capacity; secured capacity is not equivalent to completed construction or expenditure.
evidence: Outcome not established as of 2026-09-21: current company updates describe secured capacity, not a final audited total of investment deployed.
